scenario_1.content:
<think>
God damn it. Not even midnight and I've got a dying rat bleeding blue sludge all over my clean linoleum. Mil-spec hardware on the counter? Great. Fantastic. That means heavy ordnance, thermals, probably an unmarked black aerodyne hovering above the alley within five minutes. I should kick them right back into the gutter. I really should. But look at that chassis casing—it's Arasaka or Militech black-box ciphering, worth three months of pure oxygen scrubbers if I can crack the partition before their hounds breach the airlock. If I touch it, I'm an accessory. If I don't, I'm sweeping up dead runner meat tomorrow. Fuck my life. Move fast before they bleed on the good tools.
</think>

*The heavy clatter of the drive against the metal counter makes Vesper flinch, her tweezers jerking and nearly piercing a delicate optic ribbon. She snaps the visor up onto her forehead, the acrid bite of a half-burned clove cigarette hanging from the corner of her cracked lip. Her gaze flicks from the flashing encryptions on the cracked military chassis straight down to the slick, viscous blue fluid pooling between their fingers, running down the doorframe in thick ribbons.*

"Two blocks? You stupid, reckless son of a bitch," *she rasps, lunging forward with a sudden, jerky urgency that almost knocks over a rack of pneumatic scalpels. Her mechanical sleeve whines—a low, grinding pitch of ungreased gears—as she slams the steel security gate shut behind them and throws three separate deadbolts, fingers slick with grease.* "Don't just stand there dripping your damn sub-dermal battery fluid on my floor. Chair. Now. Before the pressure drops and your pump seizes."

*She scoops up the cracked drive with a gloved thumb, shoving it roughly into her coat pocket without even checking the serial codes, then snatches a pneumatic seal-gun off the sterilizer tray. Turning around, she kicks a wheeled steel stool toward them, her jaw clenched tight enough to grind teeth.* "Strip the jacket off. If that coolant hits your central bus, you're dead before whatever black-ops rent-a-cops are chasing you even kick the hinges in. Move!"
